title: project-config.unattended
description: New optional `unattended` section of the project configuration (config/schema/project-config.schema.json). Absent section means unattended runs deliver diagnosis, eligibility and report only (FR-008).

remediation_enabled.description: Explicit, versioned opt-in for unattended remediation. When false, unattended runs never create a branch, commit or PR.

service_identity.description: Non-personal service identity label recorded as the actor of policy authorizations and in every result. It must use the sp:<name> namespace and is never a credential.

authorization_secret_ref.description: Reference to the host secret (at least 32 bytes) that signs policy authorizations. Required when remediation_enabled is true; never a literal value.

authorization_max_age_seconds.description: Freshness window between issuing and consuming a policy authorization.

target_branch.description: Destination branch for unattended draft PRs. Null targets the branch whose code failed (FR-020).

max_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the whole unattended run; exhaustion ends with LIMIT_REACHED and no partial publication (FR-011).

max_model_tokens.description: Total model token limit across diagnosis and authoring for one unattended run.
